sceneConcept: A tall lean fifty-six-year-old white British training instructor stands alone against a transparent background with perfectly upright military bearing. His close silver-grey crew cut, blue eyes, heavy brows and clean-shaven weathered face convey exacting patience. He wears a completely plain olive training jacket over a dark collared shirt, straight black trousers, polished military boots and a simple wristwatch. Standing rigidly at attention with both arms behind his back, he inspects the viewer as though evaluating a recruit. Soft even frontal studio light preserves the restrained instructor silhouette.
naturalLanguageDetail: A tall lean fifty-six-year-old white British training instructor with a close silver-grey crew cut and blue eyes stands rigidly at attention with both arms behind his back, wearing a completely plain olive training jacket and polished military boots under soft even frontal studio light; the portrait is framed from head to mid-thigh in a strict cowboy shot, with lower legs and feet outside the image.
